input.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry commercial general liability, professional liability (E&O) and cyber liability insurance, with certificates on request.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision, so we added standard coverages appropriate for a vendor that hosts our web site and processes consumer credit data, together with certificates on request. If USD 5,000,000 cyber cover is not currently in place, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering Client Content and any other data of Client or its customers processed, hosted or transmitted by TrueLink; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
